articleTitle: Spinalonga: Why It Was Fortified and How the Island’s Uses Changed
targetAudience: Readers interested in East Crete history

editorialCore.centralQuestion: How did Spinalonga’s changing uses shape its connection with Elounda and Plaka?
editorialCore.thesis: The island’s physical fabric records successive defensive, residential, compulsory-isolation and conservation uses.
editorialCore.viewerValue: A careful orientation to supported historical context.
